draft_wording: Hierarchical prediction errors validate predictive coding theory in the decoding setting

alternative_explanations: Heads never receive gradient; they report a RANDOM linear projection of trained features. Not noise - produces stable plausible figures.

draft_wording: Prediction errors carry more information than raw activations
alternative_explanations: Existing analysis computes residual MAGNITUDE, not information (rule 8). Residuals optimized only for CLIP retrieval = arbitrary task features until shown to predict held-out neural activity (Risk 2).

draft_wording: v4 regularization reduced overfitting (25pp gap vs v1's 82pp)

draft_wording: A neural-prediction constraint learned only from perception is EVALUATED as a source of zero-shot robustness across stimulus/noise/data/subject shift
alternative_explanations: The surviving candidate. Note 'evaluated as', not 'is' -- nothing has been run. Spera et al. use NO auxiliary neural-prediction objective (confirmed at full text), so the mechanism is untested by them. But with imagery removed, the entire scientific content rests on ARM-B vs ARM-C and ARM-B vs ARM-F.

draft_wording: Spera et al. pool 10 reconstruction seeds x 4 subjects = 40 units into their SEM
statistical_result: SEM computed across 10 VD seeds x 4 subjects per condition
alternative_explanations: Seeds are repeated draws from one model on one stimulus, not independent stimulus evidence, so the SEM understates uncertainty. Their SIGNIFICANCE tests are subject-level Wilcoxon (n=4), which is correct. A legitimate observation about error bars only - do not overstate it, do not lead with it, it does not touch their central claim.

draft_wording: ARM-B outperforms tuned regularization (ARM-F)
alternative_explanations: Gated on O-8 (28_O8_TUNING_PROTOCOL.md): equal grids (4 candidates x 2 seeds per arm), equal updates, identical early-stop and selection rule, selection on NSD val_r@1 ONLY with no readout of Synthetic/SHARED1000/Imagery/reduced-data/noise/LOSO/neural-predictivity, and every trial logged including failures. The gate is PROCEDURAL and does not depend on the result. E-P1 (1 config/arm x 2 seeds) is a futility screen and may NOT be used to select lambda and then report evidence for the selected lambda.

draft_wording: The cross-shift compound claim (B improves in >=2 of 5 shifts) is formally calibrated
statistical_result: partial conjunction (Benjamini-Heller 2008) r=2 n=5 Bonferroni; Type-I 0.044-0.051 under the one-true-shift null vs 0.071-0.079 for the withdrawn BH-count rule; power 0.929 with two true shifts
alternative_explanations: The withdrawn '>=2 BH discoveries' rule inflates Type-I ~1.6x precisely when ONE shift is real. BH is retained only as secondary localization and does not license the compound claim. Simes is sensitivity-only; a Bonferroni/Simes disagreement is itself reported.
